section_summary.extract_value: This section presents preliminary analyses for a single study with a total sample of 196 women. It details mean ratings for current breast size and ideal breast size using the BSRS, as well as breast size dissatisfaction. The section also reports correlations between current breast size ratings, actual bra size, and BMI, and concludes with preliminary support for the construct validity of BSRS scores in Brazilian women.
